title: NHI component to the New Jersey drone flap

tellings.quote: I do think that there was a an NH NHI component to this combined

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he once helped retrieve a UFO, talks about the wave of mysterious drone sightings over New Jersey in 2024. He says he thinks there was a non-human intelligence part to it, mixed in with other things. If so, some of those lights in the sky would not have been made by people.
